exact_statement: Let p+,p- be any complete finite probability laws, q=(p++p-)/2, and pi any partition. Prescribe block probability profiles r+,r- with (r++r-)/2=pi(q) and r_tau(z)>0 whenever a_tau(z)=(pi p_tau)(z)>0. Among complete reference pairs with pi(R_tau)=r_tau and (R++R-)/2=q at EVERY fine label, the finite minimum M of average KL(p_tau||R_tau) exists and is at least L=average KL(a_tau||r_tau). Equality M=L holds IFF, for every block occupied by both actual children, either r+(z)=a+(z) or p+(.|z)=p-(.|z); singly occupied and zero blocks cause no extra obstruction. Equivalently (r+(z)-a+(z))*(a-(z)*p+(s)-a+(z)*p-(s))=0 for all s in doubly occupied blocks. Failure makes M strictly greater than L. M=1/8+(1/2)log2(4/3), L=(3/4)log2(4/3), and M-L=1/8-(1/4)log2(4/3)>0, certified by16<18. At the TRUE full parent reference, the complete erasure-plus-mean-child-CE increment includes JS and equals M-JS=(1/8)log2[5^5/(2^7*3^4)]<0. Thus the fine gap is not an unpaid net transaction. Full-mean compatibility and prescribed profiles are explicit extra route obligations, not forced by Booleanity; no initial-source or full FEI bound follows. Units bits.

Among complete references R+,R- with pi(Rtau)=rtau and (R++R-)/2=q, the mean CE increase is minimized by minimizing -(1/2) sum_{p(s)>0} p(s) log2(1-t(s)^2), subject to Rtau(s)=q(s)(1+tau*t(s)) and sum_{pi(s)=z}q(s)t(s)=Delta(z)=(r+(z)-r-(z))/2. Its minimum is zero iff |Delta(z)|<=g(z)=sum_{pi(s)=z,p(s)=0}q(s) for every block. Beyond that capacity, ghost tilts saturate at sign Delta and the unique occupied minimizer satisfies p(s)t(s)/(1-t(s)^2)=lambda(z)q(s), with lambda fixed by the block constraint; fully one-sided occupied boundaries have infinite cost. If p,q have matching conditionals in each occupied block, the minimum equals -(1/2)sum_z pi(p)(z) log2(1-((r+(z)-r-(z))/(2*pi(q)(z)))^2).
